title: hal-nemoFinder Regression Set
description: Schema for a labelled regression set consumed by hal-nemoFinder's CalibrationTracker.  A regression set is a list of factual claims with ground-truth hallucination labels, used to measure classifier accuracy, Brier score, and Expected Calibration Error on a fixed benchmark.  Files may be encoded as a top-level JSON list, a JSONL file (one object per line), or a YAML list.  YAML and JSON files may also wrap the list under a top-level 'claims' key.

claim_type.description: Which routing bucket this claim falls into.  Determines which verifiers see it.
Optional pre-classified type. Defaults to general_biomedical when omitted.

ground_truth_label.description: True if the claim is actually a hallucination, False otherwise.  Either this field or is_hallucination must be provided.

is_hallucination.description: Alias for ground_truth_label.  Either this field or ground_truth_label must be provided.
